task.description:
rework for FAIL handoffs/M1CODE-20261119-01/step-01d-code-design-validator.json, gate pass 2 of 3 — WF-02, step 1 (rework), CODE-DESIGNER, run M1CODE-20261119-01 (task M1.4 of PUBLIC-V1: REQ-111, REQ-112). Close each remark below in docs/design/REQ-111-112-public-landing.md (or keep the text and say why in result.issues with evidence), keep what the gate did not question, re-run on a clean copy the trials a change touches, and record them. decisions/0124 (О13: the build starts from base/M1CODE-20261119-01-build and every command naming base/<RUN-ID> reads that tag for this run; О14: the one narrow IB-1 row) and decisions/0123 with its Addition of 2026-11-19T20:44Z (L1, L3, L4) bind.

Remarks (gate pass 2, step 01d):
- G1 [medium] Section 10 LD-5, LD-6, LD-7, LD-9 against LD-1; section 9 row REQ-111/12; section 13 (no mutant); 4.10 item 4: REQ-111 criterion 12 asks: «On every page and in every state of the demo that the test reaches, in each language», the text the page shows must pass the lint of criterion 3, the word ban and the phrases, «so a text that a page script writes is linted as well». The catalogue lints only in LD-1, when each page loads. LD-5, LD-6, LD-7 and LD-9 reach the question, result, no-match and failure states, where the scripts write their texts, and none of them applies the lint. check-public's lint (4.10 item 4) reads the texts module, the .html files and the intake, not the string literals of a page script. Section 13 has no mutant for the rule. So a demo.js that writes «бесплатно» into the result after a tap is green in every test of the catalogue. Fix: in LD-5, LD-6, LD-7 and LD-9, apply LD-1's lint and word ban to innerText and to alt, title and aria-label after each state the test reaches, in the page's language. Add a section 13 mutant (a page script that writes a list form only after a tap) and name the test that kills it (LD-6 or LD-7). Carry both into row REQ-111/12.
- G2 [medium] 4.11 stripRegions and writePublicSet step (5); E14; section 7; PB-6; section 13: the cut pairs an opening marker with the nearest end marker of its kind, and the guard looks only at the output. An opening marker left unclosed before a later region of its kind (nested, or its end marker missing) is paired with the next region's end marker: everything between is cut and no marker is left (measured by the gate: no throw, the footer's home link cut). An unclosed marker at the end and a stray end marker do throw. On the designer's f2pages with block D's end marker dropped, the negative checks and PB-2's strict comparison are green; only PP-7 and PB-6's content rule are red. So E14's «exit 1», section 7's «nothing reaches the platform's output unchecked» and PB-6's «a planted unclosed region … makes writePublicSet throw» do not hold for this shape. Fix: before any cut, writePublicSet checks the pairing of the markers in each .html file and throws, naming the file, on an opening marker while one of its kind is open, an end marker with none open, or a marker never closed. PB-6 names its planted shapes and their positions: a region left open before a later one, a nested opening marker, a stray end marker. Section 13 gains the mutant «the cut with no pairing check».
- G3 [low] Section 11 row 5, the damaged copies of the IB-1 row in IB-2: the gate's mutant of the row that matches the twin by file name in any folder leaves IB 4 of 4 green against all ten damaged copies; no damaged copy pins «the same path». Fix: add a damaged copy — server/lib/picker-engine.d.ts beside a plain server/lib/picker-engine.js, with the vendored list [server/vendor/picker-engine.js], red — and the mutant to section 13. With the rework or at T1.
- G4 [low] LD-4, F42, the console rules of LD-1 and fixtures/browser.js: measured in Chrome 157 through playwright-core 1.64.1, a second getImageData read of the same canvas prints the console warning «Canvas2D: Multiple readback operations using getImageData…»; LD-4's three rounds over four avatars print four such lines; a copy into a willReadFrequently canvas prints none. The e2e allows only declared console lines, and F42 does not name this one. Fix: read the avatar pixels through a copy into a canvas made with { willReadFrequently: true } (or once per canvas and state), and name the fact in F42. With the rework or at T4.
- G5 [low] F39 and F40; section 10 NPM-6 paragraph; T1: the designer's sketch of replacement row 8 is red by the fix round's NPM-6: its comment «…read only: it stands…» is hit as `only:`. F39's «4 of 4» was measured with the VB file alone, and section 10 says «no new file», while NPM-6 reads changed files and comments too. Fix: section 10 says every new or changed file under app/test, comments included, avoids the selector forms; measure F39 again with NPM-6 on the same tree. With the rework or at T1.
- G6 [low] Section 12 B3 against B2: B2 leaves CP-2's js/ line red until T1 and comes before B3; B3's own check says «only NPM-3 red (and IB-1, from B1)», so CP-2 is red at B3 but not on its list (WF-02 step 2). Fix: B3's check names NPM-3, IB-1 (from B1) and CP-2 (from B2) as the expected red tests.
- G7 [low] Section 10 ST-2 against decisions/0123 Addition 2026-11-19T20:44Z, L3: ORCH's reading L3 says «no label is cut» holds at every moment and only «no two labels overlap» is read when «Вы» stands; ST-2 reads both at that moment. Fix: ST-2 checks «no label cut» also on the frames of a walk (or shows, by a measurement, that a label's box cannot change during a walk), and the overlap when «Вы» stands, citing L3.

Rules (docs/workflows/handoffs.md, «Common rules for all roles»): write only the design and this handoff; trials only in a fresh git clone outside the project; no commit, push, tag, stash, reset, checkout, clean or branch switch in the project or any copy; no path of the computer in a Sai file; result.changes holds the table «what was fixed, where» by remark; new questions only ORCH can answer go in open questions with a default. Before close: cd tools && npm run handoffs-check and npm run traces.
acceptance_criteria: Every remark G1–G7 is closed in the design, or kept with the reason and evidence in result.issues
The trials a change touches are re-run on a fresh clone of base/M1CODE-20261119-01-build outside the project and recorded with command and output

G3: the eleventh damaged copy server/lib/picker-engine.d.ts and M92, measured (F47). G4: LD-4 reads the avatars through a willReadFrequently copy, F42 names the console warning of a second read (F48). G5: section 10 says every new or changed file under app/test, comments included, keeps clear of NPM-6's forms; F39 measured again under NPM-6 on the same tree (F49: unit 47 of 47, int 36 of 36 with rows 5 and 8). G6: B3's expected reds NPM-3, IB-1, CP-2, measured (F50: 43 of 46). Counts: named tests 96 unchanged; mutants 93 (M88–M93 new); facts 51; open questions 15, none new (О15 of step 01c still has no record: issue I5).
